name: Scenario B: Declined Audit
description: Highland Timber submits a treated Scots Pine batch but the chain-of-custody documentation gap and a non-permitted preservative cause the auditor to decline. No credential issued.

1.supportingEvidence: Harvest licence FCS-HL-26-0521. FSC certificate scan attached but expiry 2025-11-30. Treatment supplier datasheet provided.

2.auditFindings: FSC certificate covering Loch Ness Estate Compartment 7 expired 2025-11-30, four months before harvest date. Tributyltin oxide is on the FSC restricted-substance list — its use disqualifies the batch under both FSC and PEFC schemes. Supplier requested to re-apply once a valid FSC certificate is in place and an alternative non-restricted preservative is used.
2.declineReason: Chain-of-custody certificate expired before harvest date, and a treatment chemical (Tributyltin oxide) is on the FSC restricted-substance list. Re-apply once a valid FSC certificate covers the compartment and a non-restricted preservative is used.
